atomic_reference_calibration.convention: GPAW reports energies relative to setup reference atoms; add get_reference_energy() to recover the consistent absolute PAW total energy. setup.py929-942 subtracts reference kinetic/XC/electrostatic terms; setup.py1341 sums reference totals; new/calculation.py285 labels relative energies; new/ase_interface.py490 exposes the offset.
atomic_reference_calibration.sensitivity: Omitting the2H-minus-He reference offset changes the physical neutral adiabatic result by the recorded offset. Host-minus-vacuum metal excess cancels it and is a distinct quantity.

cases.control_scope: Observed4/8-metal periodic-cell plus k-grid-shape change and8/10A atom-box change; not a rigorous asymptotic image bound or all-electron physical error. Fixed ions, neutral Born-Oppenheimer D=H proxy.

neutral_adiabatic.definition: Neutral Ue_ad=E(host+DDfar)-E(host+He) after restoring GPAW PAW atomic reference offsets. Signed metal excess=Ue_ad-[2E(H_atom_doublet)-E(He_atom_singlet)]. Same neutral electron total within each host pair.
